pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to losing or flat positions; pyramiding is only authorized after a position has achieved a minimum floating profit of +$10.00 with trailing stops locked in.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory multi-timeframe confirmation requiring the 5-minute ATR to be below the 20-period median and price action clearing the 15-minute swing high/low before entry authorization.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation at +$10.00 profit and execute scale-out harvests at +$15.00 and +$30.00 targets.
